comment: Vercel hosts the React frontend (artifacts/web) as a static SPA.
The Express API is deployed separately on Render (see render.yaml); its public
URL is provided to the build as VITE_API_BASE_URL.
IMPORTANT — VITE_API_BASE_URL is a BUILD-TIME variable. Vite inlines it into the
bundle at build time, so it must be set in the Vercel project's Environment
Variables BEFORE the build runs. Changing it later requires a redeploy; setting it
only at runtime has no effect.
Build & output settings live here so Vercel needs no manual dashboard configuration
beyond the environment variable above. The install/build run from the repo root so
the pnpm workspace (and the frontend's @workspace/* dependencies) resolve correctly.
